generation.reference_proportions_are_pre: Reference proportions are preserved; use a multiple of 16.

image_processing.0_keeps_the_source_dime: 0 keeps the source dimension or derives it from the other dimension.
image_processing.white_selects_pixels_ex: White selects pixels. Extract a channel or color from the source, or upload an exact-frame grayscale mask. The mask result can be attached to its source in the image workspace.
image_processing.blend_clamps_rgb_to_0_1: Blend clamps RGB to 0–1. Transfer requires sRGB in 0–1 and also clamps its result. Quantize uses the native RGB8 palette conversion. Source alpha is preserved.
shell.transform_size_follows_its_operati: Transform size follows its operation controls.
generation.super_resolution_uses_the_nat: Super-resolution uses the native twofold Cascade stage grids. Explicit output sizes keep their exact target; the full source is fitted and padded. Vision references guide Stage C without replacing the prompt.
generation.add_the_super_resolution_sour: Add the super-resolution source in Native image edit or Image to image. Ordinary Cascade compression and source denoise apply when super-resolution is disabled.
generation.vision_images_are_request_inp: Vision images are request inputs. Library setup restores the model and strengths; attach the reference images again in the same order.
generation.one_number_per_image_separate: One number per image, separated by commas, from -10 through 10. Blank uses 1 for each image. Zero disables that image's contribution.
generation.choose_a_separate_sdxl_refine: Choose a separate SDXL refiner and the step where the base hands it the noisy latent. Both stages share the total steps, sampler, scheduler, seed and denoise.
generation.used_for_split_refiners_final: Used for split refiners. Final decoding uses the base model's selected SDXL VAE.
generation.required_when_a_refiner_is_se: Required when a refiner is selected. Use one through total steps minus one.
generation.blank_uses_the_base_cfg_zero_: Blank uses the base CFG. Zero is an explicit override.
image_editing.choose_an_installed_bundle: Choose an installed bundled Stage B checkpoint. Blank sampling fields use its verified recipe when available; otherwise enter them explicitly. Native image edit and Image to image use the source image's native Cascade grids. Masks are unavailable.
image_editing.used_only_with_a_source_im: Used only with a source image. Zero preserves the encoded Stage C prior.
generation.each_generation_returns_order: Each generation returns ordered transparent layers. Image count controls repetitions.
generation.describe_the_overall_scene_ke: Describe the overall scene. Keep automatic upscaling off and use PNG or EXR.
image_processing.choose_a_local_rt_detr_: Choose a local RT-DETR model for detection or SAM 3 / 3.1 for segmentation.
image_processing.minimum_confidence_for_: Minimum confidence for object detection or text segmentation.
generation.use_native_files_with_their_o: Use native files with their original model, codecs and text encoders. generation.required_automatically_for_la: Required automatically for layers, masks and references. Complex files can be replayed only with this app's original saved-context receipt.
generation.requires_a_staged_sdxl_base_r: Requires a staged SDXL base/refiner request. Resume this file with its original prompts, sources, seed and full schedule.
generation.use_native_safetensors_files_: Use native safetensors files from the same ordinary SD1, SD2, SDXL, SD3 or Flux model and matching codec/text encoders. generation.choose_the_original_family_fo: Choose the original family for external files without saved RuinedFooocus context.
generation.lower_values_retain_more_of_t: Lower values retain more of the imported latent. Full denoise can discard it in flow models.
generation.export_native_positive_and_ne: Export native positive and negative conditioning
image_processing.restore_one_still_image: Restore one still image with SeedVR2 and its matching codec. The complete resized source and alpha are preserved, including odd-sized edges.
image_processing.for_example_person_3_do: For example: person:3, dog:2. Use text, points or boxes. Text needs the SAM model's language encoder.
image_processing.apply_curves_or_a_named: Apply curves or a named image effect on CPU or with native GLSL acceleration. One source up to 4 megapixels and 4096 pixels per side; size and alpha are preserved. No model is needed. CPU mode and automatic CPU fallback are supported.
image_processing.use_2_to_32_points_per_: Use 2 to 32 points per curve, with input and output values from 0 to 1. Input values must increase, starting at 0 and ending at 1. Master RGB runs before the separate channels.
image_processing.apply_this_filter_to_on: Apply this filter to one source image. Its size and alpha are preserved. No model or prompt is needed.
image_processing.1_keeps_the_original_br: 1 keeps the original brightness or contrast.
image_processing.analyze_this_source_wit: Analyze this source without a model. Shows 256 bins for RGB, BT.709 luminance and each channel. All pixels count, including transparent pixels. Colors use their stored RGB values.
image_processing.image_histogram_five_ch: Image histogram; five channels, bins zero to 255
shell.this_image_tool_keeps_the_source_i: This image tool keeps the source image size.
image_processing.large_images_also_have_: Large images also have a combined mask pixel limit.
generation.this_installed_model_is_an_im: This installed model is an image utility. Choose its matching Image tool.
image_processing.the_installed_utility_c: The installed utility changed. Refresh and select it again.
image_processing.the_sam_checkpoint_did_: The SAM checkpoint did not load its paired language encoder.
image_processing.text_segmentation_needs: Text segmentation needs the selected SAM checkpoint's paired language encoder.
image_editing.minimax_h3_image_uses_its_: MiniMax H3 Image uses its PDD schedule, 32B conditioning encoder and image VAE. Use None for text-to-image or Native image edit with up to four ordered pictures. Refer to them as <Picture 1>, <Picture 2>. Transparent inputs use a neutral background; outputs are opaque RGB.
image_processing.wevisone_keeps_the_sour: WeVisOne keeps the source size. Cutouts multiply the original alpha by the native matte; grayscale mattes contain the native mask.
image_processing.for_detection_enter_one: For detection, enter one object label per line. For matting, describe the subject.
gallery.this_image_has_no_valid_image_co: This image has no valid image composition recipe.
image_processing.add_ordered_images_a_gr: Add ordered images. A grid uses every image; composition uses base first, overlay second. Images fit with padding, never cropping. Working copies are 8-bit sRGB; originals are retained.
image_processing.these_image_tools_run_o: These image tools run once and do not use a generation checkpoint, prompt, LoRA or sampling settings.
image_processing.grid_output_is_opaque_r: Grid output is opaque RGB on black. Transparent source pixels and empty cells use black.
image_processing.the_base_defines_the_ou: The base defines the output canvas. Zero rectangle width or height uses the available area. The overlay and its mask fit the same rectangle; source alpha is retained.
image_processing.overlay_selection_mask_: Overlay selection mask (optional): white selects, black preserves
image_processing.compose_two_saved_laten: Compose two saved latents from this installation with the same original context, dtype and complete shape. No generation checkpoint or sampling is used. The result is one latent file; the image gallery is retained.
image_processing.offsets_and_feathering_: Offsets and feathering must align to the saved codec grid (8 or 16 pixels). The destination canvas stays fixed; explicit offsets clip the overlay at its edges. A mask must match the complete saved image canvas.
image_processing.original_uploads_and_co: Original uploads and context receipts are required. Re-upload the same two originals and mask to repeat this operation; saved output records their hashes and exact parameters.
image_processing.latent_selection_mask_w: Latent selection mask: white copies the overlay
image_processing.boxes_must_be_bounded_j: Boxes must be bounded JSON with x, y, width and height in source pixels.
image_processing.sam_text_must_be_at_mos: SAM text must be at most 1024 literal characters without control codes.
image_processing.use_one_to_16_native_sa: Use one to 16 native SAM text categories.
image_processing.maximum_instances_must_: Maximum instances must be an integer between 1 and 64.
image_processing.individual_masks_must_b: Individual masks must be true or false.
image_processing.add_a_positive_point_a_: Add a positive point, a source-image box or a text category for segmentation.
image_processing.each_native_sam_text_ca: Each native SAM text category must request one to 64 detections.
image_editing.scheduled_sources_apply_af: Scheduled sources apply after the selected and prompt LoRAs. Checkpoint sources use the native difference from the primary model weights. File compatibility is checked on Run.
image_editing.keyframes_hold_until_the_n: Keyframes hold until the next start. Before the first start, the model uses the first multiplier and scheduled CLIP uses its base strength. The last multiplier continues afterward. Steps and denoise affect which keyframes run.
image_editing.this_checkpoint_has_no_ext: This checkpoint has no external CLIP target. Set CLIP strength to 0 for model-only hooks.
image_editing.at_most_8_sources_total_ea: At most 8 sources total. Each entry needs type (lora or checkpoint) and name; optional model_strength, clip_strength and keyframe settings override the controls above.
image_editing.copy_selected_loras_into_s: Copy selected LoRAs into scheduled sources
image_editing.when_disabled_clip_uses_it: When disabled, CLIP uses its constant strength. Model hooks always use the keyframes.
image_editing.ordered_start_strength_pai: Ordered start/strength pairs, beginning at 0. Example: [{"start":0,"strength":1},{"start":0.5,"strength":0}]
image_editing.one_through_100_signed_mul: One through 100 signed multipliers, evenly spaced between the first and last start.
image_editing.hypernetworks_use_matching: Hypernetworks use matching SD attention dimensions on the primary checkpoint. A handoff refiner keeps its own attention. Signed strength controls the native attention transform.
image_editing.guidance_is_off_until_a_lo: Guidance is off until a local model is selected. Expand or refresh to list local files.
image_editing.hypernetworks_use_matching: Hypernetworks use matching SD attention dimensions. Signed strength controls the native attention transform.
image_editing.describe_each_box_literall: Describe each box literally with text, x, y, width and height. Use ordered boxes and multiples of eight on a fresh image canvas.
image_editing.gligen_layout_uses_its_mat: GLIGEN layout uses its matching SD checkpoint and CLIP. Keep image tools, staged refiners and automatic upscaling off.

image_processing.use_box_json_with_x_y_w: Use box JSON with x, y, width and height in source pixels.
image_processing.each_box_needs_exactly_: Each box needs exactly x, y, width and height.
image_processing.boxes_must_have_positiv: Boxes must have positive size and stay inside the oriented source image.
image_processing.use_native_sam_categori: Use native SAM categories such as person:3, dog:2.
